title: Prescribed Force Trajectories as Benchmarks for Longitudinal EMG Decoding: Reproducibility Archive
description: Frozen presubmission reproducibility archive for the manuscript 'Prescribed Force Trajectories as Benchmarks for Longitudinal EMG Decoding'. This release contains the executable reconstruction of the central protocol-defined temporal-prior benchmark, fixed analysis specifications, recovered plotting provenance for secondary analyses, and frozen numerical summaries supporting the manuscript.
